messages.subject: GGIR training sessions in the upcoming weeks!
parts:
Dear all,

In the upcoming weeks we are organising new series of GGIR training sessions. These are led by Jairo Hidalgo Migueles with me in a supporting role.

For detailed information see: https://www.accelting.com/ggir-training/

In summary:
  • 6 and 7 November: R essentials for GGIR ideal for those with no R experience!
  • 13, 15 and 17 November: Standard GGIR training, with still plenty of seats available in the early-day session suitable for those based in Asia/Africa/Middle-East/Europe. the late day sessions suitable for the Americas on the other hand is almost fully booked.

This is a commercial service because GGIR itself is for free, so we need a form of income in order to pay our bills. You can pay via the website with your Creditcard or if applicable your PayPAL account.

Best regards and looking forward session some of you at the training.

Vincent

Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
